ephemeris.t0_source: Zeng et al. (2024), Table 6: 2460232.18988(09), labelled HJD. https://arxiv.org/html/2411.06803v1#S0.T6
ephemeris.period_source: AAVSO VSX, CZ Aqr (OID 971), and Zeng et al. (2024), Eq. 1, give 0.86275209 d. The retained working value differs by -0.00000001 d. https://vsx.aavso.org/index.php?view=detail.top&oid=971
ephemeris.comment: Fixed plotting ephemeris; fitted eclipse epoch is reported separately. HJD_UTC is the project convention; the source table labels HJD without specifying UTC/TDB. The working-period difference accumulates to about 1.1 s by these observations.
